neighbours.label: word-final pieces of wild animal names, especially game and prey animals (hare, grouse, springbok)
fire: The fox crept through the snow toward the sleeping hare.
Hunters in the highlands still shoot red grouse each August.
The menu offered grilled springbok with a red wine sauce.
A herd of impala grazed near the river at dusk.
The owl swooped down and caught a young pheasant.
In autumn the hunters went after wild boar in the forest.
Wolves on the island survive mostly by hunting moose.
Lions on the plain chased a single wildebeest.
quiet: The fox crept through the snow toward the sleeping farmhouse.
Hunters in the highlands still gather at the lodge each August.
The menu offered grilled vegetables with a red wine sauce.
A group of tourists waited near the river at dusk.
The owl swooped down and landed on a fence post.
In autumn the hunters went after mushrooms in the forest.
Wolves on the island survive mostly by staying hidden.
Lions on the plain rested under a single tree.
